title: Guaranteed Demand and Corporate R&D
near_miss_reason: The only binary staggered design is the Figure 3 end-of-Cold-War event study (industry shock years 1991-1994, firm FE + year FE, eventdd leads(4) lags(4), never-treated control firms). Every panel includes two time-varying controls (lprivate_sales and lprivate_sales_change), so no column satisfies the no-controls rule. The main tables (R&D, publications, scientists, patents) use a continuous treatment, ln(R&D contracts) lagged, in OLS and 2SLS (ivreghdfe) with lagged R&D-stock and sales controls, and are excluded as continuous-treatment/IV specifications.
eligible_reason: Not eligible as reported: staggered binary design exists only in Figure 3 and always carries time-varying controls (near miss); all tables are continuous-treatment OLS/IV or firm-trend regressions.
design_notes: DISCERN firm-year panel 1980-2015. Figure 3: treated = firms in 3-digit SIC industries whose R&D contracts rose into the top quintile (ratio >= 1.448) in 1991/1992/1993/1994 while sales changed moderately (0.933-1.151), AND which had R&D contracts in 1980-1985 (111 firms, 24 industries); controls = firms in the same shocked industries without prior contracts (1,284 firms); event = first qualifying year; eventdd lxrd/lpub_yr/lstar_stock/lpat_yr with lprivate_sales lprivate_sales_change, absorb(permno_adj year), cluster(permno_adj), keepbal(permno_adj), lags(4) leads(4). Main tables: reghdfe/ivreghdfe of ln outcomes on lrd_contracts_lag(3) with lgrd_lag(3)/lsales_lag2 controls, firm and year FE, cluster firm; instruments lpredicted_rd_lag*, lpredicted_rd_ba_lag, lpredicted_rd_budget_lag*. Trend tables (lines 1140-1232) use firm FE with a linear trend and no year FE.
estimators_reported: OLS within-firm with continuous ln(R&D contracts) and firm + year FE (Tables: rd_equations, pub_equations, renowned_scientists, pat_equations col 1)
2SLS ivreghdfe with industry-funding and windfall-budget instruments (same tables cols 2+; variation_by_size; ticket)
eventdd staggered event study with time-varying controls (Figure 3)
firm-FE linear trend regressions (trend, trend_deobligations tables)

near_miss_specs.treatment_var: yr_offset = year - event, where event (1991-1994) is the sic3 industry's Cold-War R&D-procurement shock year and is set to missing for control firms (no R&D contracts in 1980-1985); eventdd generates relative-time indicators
near_miss_specs.treatment_definition: binary staggered event: firm in a shocked 3-digit industry (R&D contracts up >= 44.8% y/y with stable sales) that had R&D contracts in 1980-1985; event year 1991, 1992, 1993 or 1994; control firms in the same shocked industries without prior contracts (yr_offset missing)
near_miss_specs.controls: lprivate_sales, lprivate_sales_change (time-varying: log private demand and its log change) - EXCLUDED under the time-varying-controls rule
near_miss_specs.sample_condition: DISCERN firms in sic3 industries with a 1991-1994 procurement shock (26 industries, 1,395 firms); keepbal(permno_adj) keeps firms observed in all event-window years; lags(4) leads(4)
near_miss_specs.exclusion_reason: two time-varying controls (lprivate_sales, lprivate_sales_change) in every event-study panel

reports_modern_estimator_note: Full-text flags mention Callaway and Sun-Abraham, but no modern estimator appears in the code.

ineligible_specs.location: Tables of R&D, publications, scientists, patents (3_main.do lines ~760-1110)
ineligible_specs.reason: continuous treatment ln(R&D contracts) with lagged controls; IV in most columns
time-varying controls lprivate_sales and lprivate_sales_change in every panel (near miss)
linear trend regressions without calendar-time FE; continuous regressors

data_access_detail: Anonymized firm-year panel DISCERN_panel.dta shipped with the variables needed for main tables and Figure 3 (sales, all_contracts, rd_contracts, lxrd, lpub_yr, lstar_stock, lpat_yr, sic3, permno_adj); raw DISCERN/Compustat/FPDS data not all redistributable.
software_detail: Stata 18.5 (reghdfe, ivreghdfe, eventdd, estout); R only for CSV conversion
replication_feasible_note: Figure 3 event study can be re-run from DISCERN_panel.dta after dropping the two controls (near-miss analysis only).
screener_notes: If a near-miss re-estimation is performed, the eventdd specification with controls dropped is: eventdd y, timevar(yr_offset) hdfe absorb(permno_adj year) cluster(permno_adj) keepbal(permno_adj) lags(4) leads(4), after the sample construction in lines 193-306.
